The package's inspected finite verifier exhaustively filters 14-point Q automorphisms and confirms C2, swapping c/f, fixing x. A full PS4 automorphism is one of those two lattice permutations; both fix the free generator, so the full automorphism is identity. For every y in F, freeness gives exactly one endomorphism x↦y, hence exactly 37; finite surjective endomorphisms are automorphisms, so x uniquely generates. Finite enumeration certifies the finite lattice calculation, while universal property supplies modal conclusion; not a finite test extrapolation.
